answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the signal of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the relic re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. By the voyage of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
